nhāru.p: [Naha+aru] (pu,na) CL=9 Naha bandane Aru; Dhāna, ṭī. 279] vein- artry-nerve. (This vein is the earth element in the four primary elements and is the seventh part in the 32 parts of the body. Abhi,ṭṭha,2.55. Visuddhi, 1. 350). It is of two kinds: (1) the vein that attaches the beginning and end of the flesh and bone, and that attaches two bones, (2) the vein that attaches two bones not to make lie separately two bones in the joint of vein and bone. There are 900 veins of this kind. See original.
